verdict.rationale: Postman documents a full REST API (postman-docs-5, postman-docs-41) for programmatically managing 'Postman assets' — collections, workspaces, etc. — and a public openapi.json spec is confirmed live (postman-probe-3), plus CLI/MCP options extend automation (postman-docs-32, postman-probe-4/5). However, the docs never claim or demonstrate full 1:1 parity between the API and every UI capability (e.g., Spec Hub design, live collaboration sessions, governance rules, Postbot/Agent Mode features appear UI/desktop-only with no confirmed API equivalents). Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or independent verification that all UI-only features (collaboration, AI agent mode, governance checks) are also API-accessible.
